mapper.select: SELECT id, org_id, user_id, message, status, created_at FROM sys_org_join_request WHERE org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, org_id, user_id, message, status, created_at FROM sys_org_join_request WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, org_id, user_id, message, status, created_at FROM sys_org_join_request WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, org_id, user_id, message, status, created_at FROM sys_org_join_request WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_org_join_request (org_id, user_id, message, status, created_at) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{userId}, #{message}, #{status}, NOW())
